title: S.E.A.T.S Inc. Holds Regular “Company Party”
excerpt: S.E.A.T.S Inc. recently held its regular internal event, the “Company Party.”The Company Party is an internal event open to all
content:
S.E.A.T.S Inc. recently held its regular internal event, the “Company Party.”
The Company Party is an internal event open to all employees who wish to participate. It provides an opportunity for members who do not normally work together to connect and interact across different departments and positions.

This time, the event was held during the Pchum Ben season, one of Cambodia’s traditional holidays. Employees enjoyed a variety of traditional Cambodian games, creating a lively and enjoyable atmosphere throughout the event.
The party also featured a variety of food, including Japanese food handled by our company. While enjoying the food and games together, employees had the opportunity to interact with colleagues they do not usually work with and strengthen relationships beyond their day-to-day responsibilities.

The event provided a valuable opportunity for employees from different departments and roles to communicate in a more relaxed setting and build stronger connections within the company.
At S.E.A.T.S Inc., we value opportunities outside of our daily work that allow our employees to connect, have fun, and build relationships with one another.

title: S.E.A.T.S Farm’s Salted Kampot Pepper to Be Sold by PASTA+ at the EXPO2025 1st Anniversary Gourmet Fair
excerpt: From October 8 to 13, 2026, our Japanese sales partner, PASTA+, will be selling S.E.A.T.S Farm’s original product, Salted Kampot
content:
From October 8 to 13, 2026, our Japanese sales partner, PASTA+, will be selling S.E.A.T.S Farm’s original product, Salted Kampot Pepper, at the EXPO2025 1st Anniversary Osaka-Kansai Expo Gourmet Fair, held at Abeno Harukas Kintetsu Main Store.
The event is being held to commemorate the first anniversary of the closing of the Osaka-Kansai Expo, bringing together a variety of food products that were featured and sold at the Expo at Abeno Harukas Kintetsu Main Store.

As one of the food products sold at the Cambodia Pavilion during the Expo, Salted Kampot Pepper will be available at the PASTA+ booth during the event.
Salted Kampot Pepper is an original S.E.A.T.S Farm product made using Kampot Pepper grown on our own farm in Cambodia. It features a fresh aroma and a unique popping texture, making it a versatile ingredient that pairs well with a wide range of dishes, including meat and seafood.

The product sold approximately 10,000 units during the 2025 Osaka-Kansai Expo, and its availability has continued to expand across the Japanese market.
In April 2026, approximately 1,000 units were sold at the Osaka Expo Gourmet Parade, held at Abeno Harukas Kintetsu Main Store, further expanding awareness of the product in Japan.
Through its return to Abeno Harukas for this special event marking the first anniversary of the Expo’s closing, we hope to introduce the unique appeal of Cambodian Kampot Pepper to both returning customers and new customers.

S.E.A.T.S Inc. will continue to expand distribution channels for S.E.A.T.S Farm products in Japan while sharing the appeal of Cambodian agricultural products with customers across Japan.

title: S.E.A.T.S Inc. Exhibits at the 3rd Cambodia Digital Trade Forum & Online Expo 2026
excerpt: From September 11 to 13, 2026, S.E.A.T.S Inc. exhibited at the 3rd Cambodia Digital Trade Forum & Online Expo 2026,
content:
From September 11 to 13, 2026, S.E.A.T.S Inc. exhibited at the 3rd Cambodia Digital Trade Forum & Online Expo 2026, held at the Koh Pich Convention and Exhibition Centre in Phnom Penh.

The Cambodia Digital Trade Forum & Online Expo is an event aimed at promoting the development of digital trade in Cambodia. It brings together a wide range of participants, including policymakers, businesses, financial institutions, and startups, with programs such as business matching, networking, and product and service exhibitions.

At our booth, we showcased our food-related businesses in Cambodia, including original products from S.E.A.T.S Farm as well as Japanese food and beverage products handled by LOKA Japanese Foods & Beverage.

From S.E.A.T.S Farm, we introduced our Salted Kampot Pepper, which has been expanding its reach not only in Cambodia but also in international markets in recent years. We also showcased our original syrup made with Oba, Japanese perilla, a crop produced in significant quantities in Cambodia.

We also displayed Japanese sake imported and distributed by LOKA Japanese Foods & Beverage, highlighting our efforts to bring Japanese food and beverages to the Cambodian market.

Through this exhibition, we had the opportunity to introduce our products and businesses to a wide range of companies and visitors, while also building connections that may lead to new business opportunities and distribution channels.

S.E.A.T.S Inc. will continue to promote business exchanges in the food and beverage sector between Cambodia and international markets, including Japan, while working to expand overseas opportunities for Cambodian products and develop new markets and distribution channels.

title: S.E.A.T.S Farm’s Green Salted Kampot Pepper Now Available at Mitsuwa Marketplace in Dallas, Texas
excerpt: We are delighted to announce that S.E.A.T.S Farm’s Green Salted Kampot Pepper is now available at Mitsuwa Marketplace in Dallas,
content:
We are delighted to announce that S.E.A.T.S Farm’s Green Salted Kampot Pepper is now available at Mitsuwa Marketplace in Dallas, Texas.

This exciting milestone has been made possible through the valued partnership of L3C USA, our U.S. import and distribution partner specializing in premium Japanese Wagyu and other high-quality food products.
Customers in the Dallas area can now enjoy one of Cambodia’s finest specialty products alongside premium Wagyu beef and other gourmet dishes. The fresh, vibrant aroma and unique popping texture of our Green Salted Kampot Pepper make it an exceptional pairing for steaks, grilled meats, seafood, and a wide variety of cuisines.

We would like to express our sincere appreciation to everyone who has contributed to bringing this collaboration between Cambodian agricultural excellence and Japanese quality standards to customers in the United States.

Since entering the U.S. market last year, we have continued to expand our presence and introduce the unique flavors of Kampot Pepper to new audiences. We look forward to sharing this exceptional product with even more customers and thank you for your continued support.

title: Featured in Rikkyo University Alumni Magazine “St. Paul” — Interview with Our Team Members
excerpt: We are pleased to announce that an interview featuring our CEO and staff member has been published in St. Paul,
content:
We are pleased to announce that an interview featuring our CEO and staff member has been published in St. Paul, the official alumni magazine of the Rikkyo University Alumni Association.

St. Paul is a publication issued by the Rikkyo University Alumni Association, highlighting the activities, achievements, and stories of people connected to Rikkyo University, including alumni and current students.

In this feature, our CEO, Kosuke Mineshima, and our staff member, Mori — both graduates of Rikkyo University — shared their personal backgrounds and career paths, as well as insights into our company’s business operations based in Cambodia. The article also introduces our original products and our efforts to connect Cambodia and Japan through food, agriculture, and cultural exchange.

title: On May 3–4, 2026, S.E.A.T.S Farm showcased and sold its original product, “Salted Kampot Pepper” at the 10th Cambodia Festival 2026 held at Yoyogi Park in Tokyo, Japan.
excerpt: At the event, multiple Cambodian companies, including S.E.A.T.S Inc., jointly exhibited under the booth organized by the Ministry of Commerce
content:
At the event, multiple Cambodian companies, including S.E.A.T.S Inc., jointly exhibited under the booth organized by the Ministry of Commerce of Cambodia, introducing Cambodian food products and culture to visitors from Japan. The festival venue welcomed large crowds throughout the two-day event and enjoyed great success.

The Cambodia Festival is an annual event aimed at strengthening the friendship between Cambodia and Japan while promoting cultural, economic, and tourism exchange between the two countries. In addition to fostering mutual understanding and people-to-people exchange, the festival also serves as an important platform for promoting trade, tourism, and investment opportunities between Cambodia and Japan. Marking its memorable 10th anniversary, this year’s festival attracted even greater excitement than previous editions. Visitors enjoyed a wide variety of programs, including traditional Khmer dance performances by Cambodian artists and live music performances by well-known Cambodian and Japanese musicians.

In addition to the exhibition at the Ministry of Commerce booth, our product was also sold at the “CAMBODIAN ARTISTS WORLD TOUR” booth, a project featuring popular Cambodian artists. As part of the Cambodian product showcase, many visitors had the opportunity to experience and purchase “Salted Kampot Pepper” allowing them to directly discover the unique appeal of Cambodian ingredients.

Through participation in international exchange events like this, we will continue promoting the appeal of Cambodian food products and culture while serving as a bridge connecting Cambodia and Japan.

A product loved in Cambodia has now crossed borders to arrive in Daikanyama, a hub of Japanese lifestyle and culture. Through this special encounter, we invite you to discover the story and flavor behind S.E.A.T.S Farm’s Salted Kampot Pepper.

title: S.E.A.T.S Farm Participated in CULT Christmas Market 2025
excerpt: On December 14, 2025, S.E.A.T.S Farm participated as an exhibitor in CULT Christmas Market 2025, held at Sofitel Phnom Penh
content:
On December 14, 2025, S.E.A.T.S Farm participated as an exhibitor in CULT Christmas Market 2025, held at Sofitel Phnom Penh Phokeethra Hotel in Phnom Penh.

The event featured approximately 100 vendors, showcasing a wide range of holiday-themed products as well as locally made Cambodian goods. The market attracted a large number of visitors throughout the day and created a festive atmosphere in line with the holiday season.

At our booth, S.E.A.T.S Farm presented its signature product, Salted Fresh Kampot Pepper, along with newly launched items including sweet potato sticks and shiso juice. As the event took place on a Sunday, it welcomed not only Cambodian visitors but also many expatriates living in Phnom Penh, as well as families with children. This provided an excellent opportunity to introduce our products to people of various nationalities and age groups.

We received positive feedback from visitors who showed strong interest in both the flavors and the background of our products, allowing us to engage directly with customers and share the story behind the S.E.A.T.S Farm brand.

S.E.A.T.S Farm will continue to actively participate in events that enable us to reach a diverse audience and further promote the appeal of high-quality Cambodian and Japanese food products.

title: S.E.A.T.S Inc. CEO Speaks at JETRO Hamamatsu Seminar on Cambodia’s Evolving Business Environment
excerpt: On December 1, 2025, JETRO Hamamatsu hosted the seminar “Evolving Cambodia: Investment Environment and Business Opportunities” in Hamamatsu City, attracting
content:
On December 1, 2025, JETRO Hamamatsu hosted the seminar “Evolving Cambodia: Investment Environment and Business Opportunities” in Hamamatsu City, attracting numerous business professionals from the region. S.E.A.T.S Inc. CEO, Kosuke Mineshima, participated as a speaker and delivered a presentation titled “Market Trends in Cambodia’s Food Sector Including Japanese Food Products,” sharing insights based on real cases from our operations in Cambodia.

The seminar also featured an update on Cambodia’s economic landscape from Mr. Nohei Wakabayashi, Chief Representative of JETRO Phnom Penh, followed by presentations from companies active in Cambodia’s manufacturing, food, and HR sectors. The event provided attendees with practical, first-hand perspectives on doing business in the country and served as a valuable platform for information exchange.

S.E.A.T.S Inc. will continue to support Japanese businesses exploring opportunities in Cambodia and the broader ASEAN region by providing accurate, on-the-ground insights and contributing to stronger economic and business ties between the two countries.

title: Hosted “Premium Japanese Sake Tasting –Nabeshima–“ at TSUTAYA Café & Bookstore
excerpt: On August 9, 2025, LOKA Japanese Foods & Beverage proudly hosted the Premium Japanese Sake Tasting – Nabeshima –, showcasing
content:
On August 9, 2025, LOKA Japanese Foods & Beverage proudly hosted the Premium Japanese Sake Tasting – Nabeshima –, showcasing six distinguished labels from Nabeshima, one of Japan’s most celebrated premium sake brands, at TSUTAYA BOOKSTORE inside AEON Phnom Penh Mall. The event aimed to increase brand awareness, deepen knowledge of Japanese sake, support sales expansion, and conduct test marketing.

Guests had the opportunity to experience a curated selection of Nabeshima sakes, including the best-selling Daiginjo, as well as unique varieties such as Aiyama and Akaiwa Omachi, each offering its own distinctive flavor profile. To complement the tasting, light dishes and desserts from the TSUTAYA café were served as suggested pairings, enhancing the appreciation of each sake’s character.

During the tasting session, our presenter shared insights into Nabeshima’s brewery history, the traditional brewing process, detailed tasting notes, and pairing recommendations. Participants gained a deeper understanding of the artistry and craftsmanship behind premium Japanese sake, with many noting, “I discovered something new” and “The pairing suggestions were very helpful.”

LOKA Japanese Foods & Beverage remains committed to promoting Japanese culinary culture in Cambodia through engaging events that provide fresh and memorable gastronomic experiences.

title: S.E.A.T.S Inc. CEO Speaks at JETRO Webinar: “Latest E-Commerce Trends in ASEAN from Local Perspectives”
excerpt: On July 17, 2025, our CEO, Mr. Kosuke Mineshima, was invited to speak at the JETRO-hosted webinar titled “Latest E-Commerce
content:
On July 17, 2025, our CEO, Mr. Kosuke Mineshima, was invited to speak at the JETRO-hosted webinar titled “Latest E-Commerce Trends in ASEAN from Local Perspectives”.

This webinar was organized by the Japan External Trade Organization (JETRO) to support the global expansion of Japanese agricultural, forestry, and fishery products, as well as food exports. The session featured speakers from various ASEAN countries who shared the latest insights and strategies on local e-commerce markets from the viewpoint of businesses operating on the ground.

Mr. Mineshima’s presentation focused on “An Overview of the Japanese Food Market and E-Commerce in Cambodia”, introducing key trends in consumer behavior, distribution structures, and the effectiveness of social media-driven strategies in the Cambodian market. Drawing from S.E.A.T.S Inc.’s local operations, he provided practical examples of how digital marketing and EC channels are successfully utilized to promote Japanese food products.

S.E.A.T.S Inc. operates with a core focus on food import and wholesale, product development, and digital marketing, serving as a cross-border business platform that connects Japan and Cambodia. Participation in this webinar offered an excellent opportunity to engage with Japanese companies interested in expanding into the ASEAN market.

Moving forward, we will continue to support the advancement of Japanese food products into ASEAN markets by leveraging our local expertise and fostering sustainable business development and international collaboration.

title: [S.E.A.T.S Inc. Participates as Cambodian Buyer at “Tochigi Food Export Business Meeting”]
excerpt: On Wednesday, July 9, 2025, S.E.A.T.S Inc. took part in the “Tochigi Food Export Business Meeting (Cambodia)” as a representative
content:
On Wednesday, July 9, 2025, S.E.A.T.S Inc. took part in the “Tochigi Food Export Business Meeting (Cambodia)” as a representative buyer from Cambodia. The event was held at the Tochigi Industry Interaction Center in Utsunomiya City, Tochigi Prefecture.


Jointly organized by the Tochigi Prefectural Government and the Japan External Trade Organization (JETRO Tochigi), the business meeting aimed to promote the export of agricultural, forestry, and fishery products—as well as processed foods—from Tochigi to Cambodia. As a local distributor of Japanese food in Cambodia, our company was honored to be invited as a key buyer to engage in direct B2B discussions with participating producers and suppliers from the region.
S.E.A.T.S Inc. operates within Cambodia through both B2B and B2C channels, supplying restaurants, hotels, and retailers while also running an e-commerce platform for individual consumers. While our strength lies in frozen seafood and meat products, we have been expanding our portfolio to include fresh produce, seasonings, and other high-quality Japanese goods to meet evolving market needs.


At the meeting, we had the opportunity to exchange insights directly with producers of story-rich sake and traditional processed foods from Tochigi. These discussions deepened our understanding of each product’s value proposition as well as the logistical considerations related to distribution in Cambodia. It was a meaningful first step toward developing long-term business relationships.


We will continue to actively participate in such trade events and work to introduce more exceptional Japanese products to Cambodian consumers, fulfilling our role as a reliable local partner in the region.

title: S.E.A.T.S Inc. Officially Participates in “Cambodia National Day” at Expo 2025 Osaka, Kansai
excerpt: On July 5, 2025, S.E.A.T.S Inc. proudly took part in “Cambodia National Day”, an official event of Expo 2025 Osaka,
content:
On July 5, 2025, S.E.A.T.S Inc. proudly took part in “Cambodia National Day”, an official event of Expo 2025 Osaka, Kansai.
National Days at the Expo are designated opportunities for each participating country to showcase its culture, industries, tourism, and diplomatic presence on the world stage. Cambodia’s celebration featured a vibrant program of traditional performances, culinary exhibitions, and industry introductions.

Our CEO Mineshima and Agricultural Division General Manager Okuda were officially invited to attend the ceremony by the Ministry of Commerce of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
As part of the program, we held a tasting session for our signature product, S.E.A.T.S Farm’s Salted Kampot Pepper. The sampling immediately drew immense attention—within just 30 seconds of opening, a long line formed in front of the booth, stretching all the way to the venue entrance, reflecting strong interest from attendees.

In addition, we co-hosted a special presentation with students from Osaka University of Arts, the creators behind the “World Onigiri Project (EXPO ONIGIRI)”. Our Salted Kampot Pepper was featured in the Cambodia-themed “Lok Lak Onigiri,” a unique culinary fusion of Cambodian ingredients and Japanese food culture. The presentation was delivered in front of distinguished guests including the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Cambodia to Japan, Cambodian government officials, and key stakeholders from the Japanese Expo Committee.

Through opportunities like this, S.E.A.T.S Inc. remains committed to deepening the friendship between Cambodia and Japan, while contributing to greater mutual understanding of agriculture and culinary culture between the two nations.

title: [Our Original Product Featured in “World Onigiri: Cambodia Edition” at Expo 2025 Osaka, Kansai]
excerpt: At the ongoing Expo 2025 Osaka, Kansai, the “EXPO ONIGIRI” project is currently being held at the rice ball specialty
content:
At the ongoing Expo 2025 Osaka, Kansai, the “EXPO ONIGIRI” project is currently being held at the rice ball specialty shop “ONIGIRI WOW!”, located within the ORA Food Pavilion “UTAGE”.

This project features four standard rice balls available throughout the Expo period, along with two themed categories: “Japanese Onigiri” and “World Onigiri.” Every month, four new rice balls are introduced under these themes.
As part of the “World Onigiri” lineup, the Cambodia-themed onigiri (Lok Lak Onigiri) is now available from June 11, 2025. Created through a co-creation project by the Department of Design at Osaka University of Arts, this special rice ball features our S.E.A.T.S Farm brand’s Salted Kampot Pepper as one of its key ingredients.

With support from Niconico Nori Co., Ltd., this initiative brings together the iconic Cambodian dish “Lok Lak” with Japan’s beloved culinary staple—onigiri—offering a unique fusion that highlights the versatility of Cambodian flavors.
We are honored that Cambodian ingredients are gaining visibility through this exciting project, and we hope this opportunity encourages more people to explore the richness of Cambodian cuisine.

In celebration of Cambodia’s National Day on July 5, our S.E.A.T.S Farm team will be on-site in Osaka to host a three-day tasting event at the Cambodia Pavilion starting July 4.
Our original product, Salted Kampot Pepper, has been available since the opening of the Expo and will continue to be sold until the event concludes on October 13, 2025.

title: Participation in THAIFEX–Anuga Asia 2025
excerpt: From May 27 to 31, 2025, our company took part in THAIFEX–Anuga Asia 2025, one of the largest food and
content:
From May 27 to 31, 2025, our company took part in THAIFEX–Anuga Asia 2025, one of the largest food and beverage trade exhibitions in Asia, held at the IMPACT Exhibition Center in Bangkok, Thailand.

Under the initiative of the Ministry of Commerce of Cambodia, our company joined eight other Cambodian enterprises in a joint exhibition to showcase a total of 28 Cambodian-made products, including:
White rice and brown rice
Various types of cashew nuts
Kampot pepper
Dried fruits (mango and pineapple)
Fruit jams, wheat crackers, assorted spices, and more

THAIFEX–Anuga Asia is a major international B2B trade fair that attracts around 3,000 exhibitors from over 50 countries and welcomes 80,000 to 100,000 visitors annually. It serves as a premier platform for exploring the latest trends, technologies, and products in the food and beverage industry, and facilitates high-level networking among buyers and industry professionals worldwide.
At the event, we participated both as a buyer engaging in trade discussions and as a product manufacturer exhibiting at the Cambodia Pavilion. This dual role allowed us to explore valuable business opportunities, establish new partnerships, and expand the global reach of our offerings.

title: LOKA Food & Beverage Participated in Major Niigata Sake Event “Niigata Sake no Jin 2024
excerpt: LOKA Food & Beverage recently participated in the prestigious sake event “Niigata Sake no Jin 2024” held in Niigata Prefecture,
content:
LOKA Food & Beverage recently participated in the prestigious sake event “Niigata Sake no Jin 2024” held in Niigata Prefecture, Japan. Inspired by the renowned Oktoberfest beer festival, “Niigata Sake no Jin” was established in 2004 to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Niigata Prefecture Sake Brewers Association. Like Oktoberfest, the event aims to celebrate local produce and connect people through delicious food and sake.

Niigata boasts the highest concentration of sake breweries in Japan, and “Niigata Sake no Jin” reflects this rich heritage. This year’s event, held on March 3rd, 2024, was one of the largest, bringing together around 80 breweries. LOKA Food & Beverage had the opportunity to participate and engage in successful business discussions with several prominent sake breweries such as Tenryohai, Abe, Kamonishiki, Koshimeijo, and Kato.

This participation in “Niigata Sake no Jin” is a significant step for LOKA Food & Beverage. The company sees this as a key opportunity to connect with leading Japanese sake producers and bring the luxurious and refined taste of Niigata sake to the high-end market in Cambodia.

After a three-year hiatus, we are excited to announce the returning of the enormous Culinary and Hospitality Expo of CAMFOOD and CAMHOTEL 2022 took place in DIECC from 16 to 17 November. For the very first time, it was incredibly a great opportunity for S.E.A.T.S Inc to participate in this event to present as one of the food importer and wholesaler known as LOKA Food & Beverage.

This global exhibition organized annually by the Cambodia Tourism Federation, the Cambodian Chefs Association, the Cambodian Restaurant Association, and the Cambodian Hotel Association with the aim of revitalizing and developing Cambodia’s HOREKA (Food and Hospitality) in Cambodia.

To celebrate the rebound of this event, a widely gathering of exhibitors was surprisingly reached to over 150 booths from 100 companies along with approximately 9,000 attendees participated and indulged the feast for the sense. This ultimate gastronomy and hospitality exhibition attracted not only a diverse range of exhibitors display variety of products and services but also professionals and decision-makers from the food and hotel sectors, such as chefs, hotel managers, restaurant owners, and buyers.

Embark of this topmost quest of the worldwide culinary and hospitality expedition, we, as one of the food and beverage importer and wholesaler among the 16 international anticipators, are pleased to introduce our products to over 3,000 visitors who had visited our booth during these three days event for the new bites experience as the passport to unlock a new destination. Regarding to our products showcase, we got to display a diverse range of products featuring from fresh fish, meat to other foods and beverages we produced and imported by our own.

During these gastronomic and hospitality expedition, we strived to offer our current and new customers with a truly unique and unforgettable new bites experience as well as tantalized the interest of our products to other business owners. Ultimately, the strenuous of our product exhibiting activity has made us become one of the Topnotch known as the Winner of the Best Booth Award at CAMFOOD&HOTEL 2022. In respect of the support from our consumers and other businesses, we promise to put more effort to always serve you with the best quality and unique experience in gastronomic expedition.

content:
The Engineering Career Fair at the Institute of Technology of Cambodia proved to be another fantastic job fair opportunity. Our organization was among the many exhibitors at the event, which was attended by recruiters and hiring managers from engineering technology, finance, and more happened on 16 August , 2022.

As one of many exhibitors, we were able to connect with potential attendees and showcase our unique value proposition. The event provided a platform for us to network with other professionals and stay up-to-date on industry trends and best practices.

The privilege we had through participating in this engineer career fair that brought together notable university elites and over a hundred influential Cambodian and international corporations became a great source of field connection with potential attendees especially in the field of food chemistry that fit to our business.

Thanks to the connections we made at the fair, we greatly expanded our network and met a vast array of attendees.
